features.definition: Navigate, extract, and transform nested data structures using dot-delimited paths, T-expressions, callable invocations, scope variables, fallbacks, and formatted error reporting.
features.name: Core Declarative Transformation and Path Traversal

features.definition: Check, validate, and conditionally branch on target data against types, regular expressions, exact values, and custom match specifications.
features.name: Pattern Matching and Validation

features.definition: Perform deep assignment and deletion operations at nested paths within dicts, sequences, and objects, with configurable policies for missing intermediate targets.
features.name: Deep Data Mutation

features.definition: Bucket target collection elements into structured groups and apply nested aggregation operations such as averages, limits, sampling, or min/max selections.
features.name: Grouping and Aggregation

features.definition: Process iterable data streams lazily with operations including mapping, filtering, splitting, chunking, windowing, deduplicating, slicing, and conditional iterations.
features.name: Lazy Streaming Transformations

features.definition: Execute glom transformations and specs directly from the console on JSON, YAML, TOML, or Python target data read from arguments, files, or standard input.
features.name: Command-Line Interface

project_purpose: glom is a Python library for declarative data transformation, restructuring, and querying of deeply nested data structures. It provides expressive path-based navigation, pattern matching, streaming, mutation, and a command-line interface for manipulating Python objects and serialized data.
